divergences.description: EntriesSearchBar is not the planned single paper-elevated box (colorSurfaceElevated, radiusMd, elevation1). It is rendered as two separate bordered pills (radiusFull, colorBorder outline, no elevation) and gains a leading search icon. The plan's review order said the widget tests check for 'no search icon', but the test now asserts the icon is present.

The filter sheet differs from spec-5-2. The plan specified the groups 'INTERVALO DE DATA' then 'TIPO DE ENTRADA', plus a 'Limpar' button that resets the pending selection. The diff adds a 'Filtrar registros' title, puts 'TIPO DE ENTRADA' first, renames the date group to 'PERÍODO', and has no 'Limpar' button at all.
Active-filter chips do not use the planned colorSecondary/colorCategoryChipText/radiusFull styling. They use a new colorSecondaryTint fill, radiusSm corners and custom padding.

New design tokens were added (colorSecondaryTint, entriesSearchBarIconSize, activeFilterChipIconGap, activeFilterChipCloseIconSize, activeFilterChipPadding), although spec-5-1 and spec-5-2 both say 'no new token'.

EntryRecordCard was redesigned outside every spec's scope: the sync badge moves from under the excerpt to the right of the header row. SyncBadge gains a new 'compact' mode that shows a lowercase label in colorTextSecondary.
The date-group heading in the timeline changes style from textTitleSm/colorTextPrimary to textMonoCaption/colorTextSecondary. No plan covers this change.

divergences.description: The plan calls for a single paper-elevated EntriesSearchBar using colorSurfaceElevated, radiusMd and elevation1. The diff instead builds two separate bordered pills (radiusFull with a colorBorder outline, no elevation1 shadow) and adds a leading Icons.search magnifying glass. That contradicts the plan's review note ('no search icon'); the new widget test asserts the search icon is present.

Spec-5-1 and spec-5-2 both say 'no new token'. The diff adds new design tokens: colorSecondaryTint, entriesSearchBarIconSize, activeFilterChipIconGap, activeFilterChipCloseIconSize and activeFilterChipPadding.

Spec-5-2 says active-filter chips use colorSecondary, colorCategoryChipText and radiusFull. The diff renders them with a colorSecondaryTint fill and radiusSm corners. It also changes the filter sheet's selected chip to a colorPrimary fill, so the two surfaces no longer share one token pair.

Spec-5-2 calls for an 'INTERVALO DE DATA' group (listed first) and 'TIPO DE ENTRADA', plus a 'Limpar' button that resets the sheet's pending selection. The diff renames the date group to 'PERÍODO', puts it after TIPO DE ENTRADA, adds a 'Filtrar registros' title, and drops the sheet's 'Limpar' button entirely. A test asserts 'Limpar' is absent.

None of the three specs mention these.
